Details: ARTHIQ demonstration and software testing dataset.
Synthetic but realistic sample records. Not real bank/customer data.
Seven complete calendar months: April through October 2026.
All transactions have unique IDs, positive INR amounts, categories and payment details.
Monthly income and expenses are calculated directly from the transaction ledger.
Closing cash = opening cash + income - expenses; next month's opening equals prior closing.
Paid invoices link to income transactions. Open invoices are not counted as cash received.
Monthly category budgets are compared against actual expenses from the ledger.
Use this for demos, UI testing and model evaluation only; it is not audited financial data.
